ambient_events: Neon light through the grimy window pulses, dims, holds.
description: A corner unit, Number 2A, riding the front of the building. Two windows face the street, one boarded, one still glassed and grimy enough to filter the neon into a permanent bruise-purple. A mattress on a bent steel frame, a hotplate wired straight into the wall, and a water stain on the ceiling shaped uncannily like a hanged man. The lock, at least, is real.

window.description: One small window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
